items.title: Hackers Steal About $2.7 Million From Polymarket Traders via Hijacked DebugBear Script
items.snippet: Malicious code on the website of prediction market Polymarket sold some signed-in traders' positions and moved their funds to the hackers on October 29. The code had replaced a page-speed script that the site loaded from an outside company. Polymarket says it is refunding about $2.7 million to 726 affected wallets. Blockchain records show crypto worth about $2.64 million reached
items.summary: Malicious code injected via a compromised third-party page-speed script stole $2.7 million from Polymarket traders. Web developers and platforms using external scripts are affected. Review external script loading and implement Subresource Integrity.

items.title: CVSS 10.0 LXD, MicroCloud Flaw Lets Attackers Impersonate Trusted Clients Without a Private Key
items.snippet: A critical flaw in Canonical's LXD and MicroCloud let an attacker log in as a trusted client without holding that client's private key. To do it, the attacker had to reach their HTTPS API over the network and have the trusted client's public certificate. items.summary: A critical authentication bypass in Canonical LXD and MicroCloud allows attackers with a trusted public certificate to impersonate clients over the HTTPS API. Review network access controls and upgrade LXD and MicroCloud to the patched version when available.

items.title: OpenAI says it's doubling Pro usage limits and bringing Work features to Chat

items.title: Alpine Linux rebuilds GitLab after attempted RCE attack
items.snippet: Hackers attempted to exploit a critical GitLab vulnerability in Alpine Linux's development infrastructure on October 20-21, prompting the open-source project to rebuild its GitLab server and reset all passwords over concerns of a possible compromise. [...]
items.summary: Hackers attempted to exploit a critical GitLab vulnerability in Alpine Linux infrastructure, prompting a server rebuild and password resets. Review account security and verify GitLab instance patching.

items.snippet: Saw Karpathy's HackerTube and wanted the same thing for books. So I had Claude build one (Opus 5.5). items.summary: HackerBooks is a searchable collection of over sixteen thousand books mentioned on Hacker News, built almost entirely by Claude Opus 5.5. Try out the tool by visiting the public website and downloading the dataset from the about page.

items.title: FBI links $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korean hackers
items.snippet: The FBI has confirmed that North Korean state-sponsored hackers known as TraderTraitor were behind the $6.3 billion crypto-theft attack on Binance, making it the largest cryptocurrency heist on record. [...]

items.title: Lenovo's 'encrypted' fingerprint USB is just an unencrypted SD card in a case
items.summary: A hardware teardown reveals that Lenovo's encrypted fingerprint USB device actually contains an unencrypted SD card. Affected users should be aware of the lack of hardware-level encryption. Check device security specifications if deploying this hardware.

items.title: Brazilian Court Sanctions Lawyers for Prompt Injection in Court Filing
items.summary: A Brazilian court sanctioned lawyers for using prompt injection in a court filing. Review legal compliance guidelines regarding AI-generated text.
